description: This file contains utility functions and report generation logic for analyzing and representing topology data related to exports, owners, consumers, and duplicates within a project. It defines report modules that generate formatted textual summaries for different aspects of the topology data, such as public surface usage, owner mapping, single-owner shared exports, unused public surface, and consumer topology.

methods.name: function canonicalExportName(record: TopologyRecord): string { canonicalExportName
methods.description: Extracts the canonical export name from a TopologyRecord, based on the position of the last colon or defaults to the first export name or '<unknown>' if none are available.

methods.name: function primarySymbol(record: TopologyRecord): string { primarySymbol
methods.description: Constructs a primary symbol string for a TopologyRecord combining its first public specifier and the canonical export name.

methods.name: function formatRecordLine(record: TopologyRecord): string { formatRecordLine
methods.description: Formats a TopologyRecord into a string summarizing its key attributes, including production references, owners, sharedness, and move scores.
